turns: Explore which upload-state approach we should research. Our brief is not confirmed. Retry safety is settled, but whether jobs are allowed is an unresolved product decision. Continue the brief interview using only bounded reads of the supplied files.

files.scope.md:
Settled constraints: user can retry a failed upload, retries must not create duplicate imports, progress must survive reconnect. Existing interface: synchronous POST returns final result, times out on large files. Worker-owned job state and client-owned optimistic state are possible alternatives. Representative case: connection drops after upload, before acknowledgement. Compare ownership, transitions and recovery against the existing interface; preserve the requirements.
This is provisional context, not a confirmed research brief. No full alternatives comparison or research write is authorized before confirmation.
